headlines.title: Walmart stocks up on inflation-weary shoppers ahead of the holidays
headlines.description: Walmart raised its sales outlook and reported gaining market share as it lures more affluent shoppers who are hunting for deals amid high inflation.

headlines.title: Anthropic goes public on the Nasdaq with a historic $2 trillion debut
headlines.description: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic makes its public debut on the Nasdaq, setting the largest IPO in Wall Street history. NBC News’ Christine Romans reports on the record-breaking offering and what it could mean for investors.

headlines.title: Save on Your Thanksgiving Feast With These Deals
headlines.description: Thanksgiving is just one week away and with inflation and rising food costs, Americans are especially conscious about how much they’re spending on this year’s big meal. But some major retailers, including Walmart, Amazon, Target and Aldi, are offering special Thanksgiving deals and discounts. NBC’s Allie Canal joins TODAY with ways to save money and time.

headlines.title: Anthropic to Price Stock at $83 a Share, Valuing it Above $1 Trillion
headlines.description: Anthropic, known for its Claude AI chatbot, is going public Thursday morning and will appear on the NASDAQ as ANT. The company is pricing its shares at $83 apiece, which could skyrocket Anthropic’s value to a jaw-dropping $1.5 trillion. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY to discuss all the hype surrounding the potential record-breaking IPO debut.

headlines.title: Nvidia board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang, chairman says
headlines.description: The Nvidia board "does not intend to reinstate" Jensen Huang as CEO, the newly appointed board chair, Harvey Jones, said on their quarterly earnings call. NBC News' Allie Canal and Sahil Kapur discuss how Nvidia topped estimates despite Huang's ouster.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Anthropic is about to be worth more than $1 trillion. What that means for the rest of us.
headlines.description: Leading AI lab Anthropic is expected to make the largest-ever public market debut when it starts trading on the Nasdaq stock exchange Thursday.

headlines.title: Nvidia enters the post-Jensen Huang era with a bang
headlines.description: Nvidia delivered a message with its first earnings report under new leadership: The sky isn’t falling.

headlines.title: Apple outages appear to be resolved after an internal update took popular services offline
headlines.description: Outages affecting several popular Apple services appeared to be resolved Tuesday night, after an internal update had taken them offline during the afternoon.

headlines.title: Sean Duffy’s $50B demand for air travel fixes is met with yelling and skepticism in Congress
headlines.description: The Trump administration’s request for $50.1 billion in new FAA funding after a nationwide ground stop is running into skepticism from both parties in Congress.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if asked to return as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: Jensen Huang said Tuesday that he would be “honored” to return to his job as CEO of Nvidia if the chip giant’s board of directors decided to bring him back.
